response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), g AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net) AS a FROM m GROUP BY mktnote), b AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS bm FROM m), k AS (SELECT g.a AS a, b.bm AS bm FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.a > b.bm) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept_net_fee_rate, AVG(a - bm) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM k;

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark average net fee rate is the overall average of (feerate - rebrate) across all matched fee-order records (record-level average, ignoring rows where either rate is missing).
Missing mktnote values form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together). Pairs whose average net rate is NULL fail the strict comparison and are dropped.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the unweighted average of the per-pair average net fee rates, rather than the record-level average.
